summary:
Architectural blueprint for transitioning MonoDo into a 5-item bottom-nav modular application:
- Custom docked Bottom Navigation Bar matching user's reference mockup with centered elevated circular '+' FAB.
- 4 distinct destination screens: Tasks (List/Filters), Stats (Weekly Matrix, Gauge, Category Analytics), Tools (Pomodoro Focus Timer & Scratchpad Notes), and Settings (Profile, Notifications, Data Backup/Export, Version).
- Complete state management and tactile haptic interactions throughout.
